title: Momo Run
one_line: A 3D endless runner: dash, jump and duck down a cobblestone road, solo or racing up to 3 friends online.
how_to_play: Computer: Space or Up to jump, Down to duck, Left and Right to change lanes. Phone: swipe up, down, left or right, or tap to jump. Race online: create a room and share the code, or join a friend's room.
description:
Momo Run is a 3D endless runner starring Momo, a little pink runner with a glowing antenna and a big love for gems. Run down a cobblestone road, collect gems and see how far you can go.

Jump over boulders and fallen logs, duck under wooden gates, and switch lanes around crate stacks and rolling barrels. Run through the FINISH gate to clear a level, grab the bonus, and the next level is a little faster under a brand-new sky: Sunny Meadow, Golden Sunset, Rainy Forest, a Thunderstorm with lightning, Snowfall, Misty Dawn and a Starry Night full of fireflies. Every weather has its own music, and gems chime higher when you chain them.

Play alone and chase your best score, or race 2 to 4 friends online. One person makes a room and shares the code, everyone runs the same road with the same gems, and the most points after 2 minutes wins. It is quick, cheerful and easy to pick up, so it suits kids, grown-ups and anyone with a few minutes to spare.
controls: Phone: swipe up to jump, down to duck, left or right to change lanes
Computer: Space or Up to jump, Down to duck
Computer: Left and Right arrows to change lanes
tips: Watch the road ahead, not Momo. Each level gets faster.
Stay in the middle lane when you can, so you can dodge either way.
Chain gems without a break to make them chime higher.
story: I wanted a happy runner game that anyone can pick up in a second. I made Momo with Claude, gave every level its own weather and music, and added online races so I can run against my friends.
